data.explanation: This is your official income tax assessment (Einkommensteuerbescheid) for 2025 from the Finanzamt. It combines your employment income and the rental income from Hafenkante 7, and after deducting your already-withheld wage tax, it shows a remaining payment of €1,624.00 due on 28 December 2026. Transfer the amount to the account shown, using your tax number as payment reference, or late-payment surcharges (Säumniszuschläge) will be added for every month you are late. If you think the assessment is wrong (for example the depreciation calculation for the rented property), you may file an objection (Einspruch) in writing or electronically with the Finanzamt; no reason is required, though one is welcome. The app will show you the deadline for this in your tasks.

items.title: File an objection (Einspruch) if you disagree
items.action: If you think the assessment is incorrect, submit a written or electronic objection to the Finanzamt Beispiel-Vegesack (or have it recorded there in person).
items.consequence: If no objection is filed within the deadline, the assessment becomes final and binding.
items.quote: Wer diesen Bescheid für fehlerhaft hält, kann dagegen innerhalb eines Monats Einspruch erheben.

items.title: Pay the remaining income tax for 2025
items.action: Transfer the remaining tax amount to the Bremer Landesmusterkasse account by the due date, using your tax number as the payment reference.
items.consequence: Late-payment surcharges (Säumniszuschläge) are added for each month started that the payment is overdue.
